propositions: Plan-review criterion T15 (overlay-derisk) must be added to reward proving risky runtime mechanisms via fast out-of-loop experiments before committing them to slow codified delivery loops (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning).
T15 is applicable when the mechanism is validated through an automated pipeline (S1), one pass is slow or costly (S2), and correctness only resolves at runtime in a realistic environment (S3).

T15 requires identifying specific runtime risks confirmable only by completing the full loop, then proving each via the fastest available path—local/emulated run or manual experiment against the real target—returning a verdict in minutes before the slow loop.
T15 requires cleanup of transient de-risk experiments to remove only artifacts created by the experiment itself, without touching pre-existing or shared resources.
T10's rubric must be partitioned to scope only durable infrastructure, explicitly excluding transient throwaway experiments used to de-risk mechanisms from T10 evaluation.
rebar registry and criteria-guide generation, writing-a-passing-plan guide, and T10 partitioning scope clause must all be implemented and validated to close acceptance criteria.
